entities.summary: The Senai Airport Mosque is a main mosque in Senai International Airport in Senai, Kulai District, Johor, Malaysia. It was built in 2003 and completed in 2010. It is also used as an international mosque for tourist who travel through Senai Airport. It is also a public mosque for Muslims from Kampung Maju Jaya and townships from Senai.
